note: Uses the atlas uncertainty group. Edges use atlas nodes probability and eigen.

description.zh: 下一步只取决于当前状态；n 步转移是转移矩阵的 n 次幂；正常的链收敛到稳态 π（πP = π），速度由第二特征值 |λ₂| 决定；有吸收态的链（赌徒）没有中间稳态。有限状态、一阶、时间齐次模型。
description.en: The next step depends only on the current state; n-step transitions are the n-th power of the transition matrix; an ordinary chain converges to a steady state π (πP = π) at a speed set by the second eigenvalue |λ₂|; a chain with absorbing states (the gambler) has no middle steady state. A finite, first-order, time-homogeneous model.

reason.zh: 转移概率就是“已知今天、明天各状态的条件概率”，把它们一步步相乘相加就得到多步转移。
reason.en: A transition probability is the conditional probability of each state tomorrow given today, and multiplying and adding them step by step gives multi-step transitions.

reason.zh: 转移矩阵的稳态是特征值 1 对应的左特征向量，其余特征值的大小 |λ₂| 决定与稳态的距离按 |λ₂|ⁿ 衰减。
reason.en: The steady state is the left eigenvector for eigenvalue 1, and the size of the next eigenvalue |λ₂| makes the distance to it decay like |λ₂|ⁿ.

label.zh: 稳态分布就是特征向量
label.en: The steady distribution is an eigenvector

reason.zh: 稳态 π 满足 πP = π：它正是转移矩阵特征值 1 的特征向量；随机游走的长期比例，本质上是一个特征问题。
reason.en: The steady state π satisfies πP = π — it is exactly the eigenvector of the transition matrix for eigenvalue 1; a random walk's long-run shares are, at heart, an eigen-problem.

title.zh: 为什么随机游走会有稳定的长期比例？
title.en: Why does a random walk have a stable long-run share?

ask.zh: 下一步只取决于当前状态时，n 步转移为什么是转移矩阵的 n 次幂？
ask.en: When the next step depends only on the current state, why is the n-step transition the n-th power of the transition matrix?

ask.zh: 第二特征值 |λ₂| 怎样决定收敛速度？特征值 1 对应的方向有什么特殊含义？
ask.en: How does the second eigenvalue |λ₂| set the convergence speed? What is special about the direction belonging to eigenvalue 1?

ask.zh: 稳态 π（πP = π）是什么意思？长期比例和单步概率有什么不同？
ask.en: What does the steady state π (πP = π) mean? How does a long-run share differ from a single-step probability?

reveal.zh: 下一步只取决于当前状态，n 步转移是转移矩阵的 n 次幂。正常的链收敛到稳态 π（πP = π），速度由第二特征值 |λ₂| 决定，有吸收态的链没有中间稳态。
reveal.en: The next step depends only on the current state, so n-step transitions are the n-th power of the transition matrix. An ordinary chain converges to a steady state π (πP = π) at a speed set by the second eigenvalue |λ₂|, while a chain with absorbing states has no in-between steady state.
